mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to fix a leaking bathroom faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to fix a leaking bathroom faucet can vary depending on the complexity of the leak, the type of faucet, and whether replacement parts are needed. Minor leaks might involve a simple washer replacement, while more extensive issues could require cartridge or valve replacement. We provide an estimate after assessing the specific problem. Generally, fixing a leak is less costly than replacing the entire faucet.
